verdict.rationale: Svelte's compiler-based approach and readable generated code, plus a report of migrating a 'huge/complex' React app successfully with better performance and dev productivity, support the story, but concrete hands-on reports contradict scaling claims: one developer hit rendering performance ceilings at high element counts regardless of interactivity (needing to fall back to canvas), and another reported the compiler 'failed badly' with transpiling bugs on a real project; testing tooling is also called a weak point for enterprise adoption. missing for 10: maintainability tooling like a mature testing story, evidence the large-scale performance issues have been resolved, and independent benchmarks refuting the scaling complaints.
